SS.detail: Single source of truth for stats. GetStat reads a cached value, recomputed when a modifier changes. Raises OnStatsChanged when modifiers change.

MODG.detail: Collider trigger for the Player. On enter, adds a GravityMultiplier modifier keyed by its sourceId. On exit, removes it. Can persist while the player stays inside.

MODZ.detail: Collider trigger that sets a custom gravity direction on GravityController. Trigger methods are verified. The configured values were not traced.

MODS.detail: Collider trigger for the Player. Adds a MoveSpeed modifier based on RunMultiplier for a fixed duration. Effects have a 0.5 s cooldown.

SPD.detail: Reads the speed multiplier each Update. Drives particle emission and optional camera FOV. Visual only.

ROT.detail: Spins a prop around chosen axes. Can face the camera. Not connected to player state.

UIIN.detail: Listens for the K action and calls UIManager.TogglePanel for the talent wheel.

UIM.detail: Opens and closes panels. Pauses time on open and close. Deactivates the camera while a panel is open. Requests an immediate save on close.

VC.detail: Cursor driven by the mouse or navigation input. Sends synthesized clicks into the UI Toolkit tree. Keeps running while the game is paused.

TTC.detail: Handles clicks on talent nodes. Left click allocates, right click removes. Checks max points, prerequisites, and dependents. Reset is scene-wired.

TTG.detail: Holds talent node data (TalentNodeDataSO) and the layout. Answers GetNodeData for the controller.

PS.detail: Holds the talent point pool and attribute allocations. SpendTalentPoint and RefundTalentPoint are used by the talent UI. Attribute spend and refund have no UI caller yet.

TSS.detail: Tracks allocated points per node. Enforces the rules that TryAllocatePoint and TryRemovePoint check. Raises the talent GameEvent when anything changes.

TEV.detail: ScriptableObject event raised on any allocation change. Listeners are scene-wired and call the save path.

GL.detail: Scene-wired MonoBehaviour. Subscribes to a GameEvent asset and calls RequestLazySave on the SaveManager when it fires.

SM.detail: Decides when to save. Lazy saves are debounced by 2 s. Immediate saves happen on panel close. Builds PlayerSaveData from talents, level, and points.

SV.detail: Writes and reads PlayerSaveData as JSON in persistentDataPath, slot default. Write errors are logged only.

DISK.detail: JSON file on disk. Holds level, talent points, and talent allocations. Attribute, vitals, and equipment fields are not written during play.

GI.detail: On Start, loads the save or creates a new game, then initializes stats, progression, and talent state. Forced new game deletes the save.

TM.detail: Owns CelestialTime, pause, day, season, and year. Raises OnDay, OnSeason, and OnYear events when they change.

WORLD.detail: Celestial, cloud, wind, skybox, and clock scripts. They poll TimeManager values rather than subscribe to events.
